spans.s: आहु [āhu], 3 U. To sacrifice, offer an oblation, worship (as fire).
Not sacrificed or offered (as an oblation); अवश्यं याति तिर्यक्त्वं जग्ध्वा चैवाहुतं हविः.

One who has not yet received any oblation. -तः Religious meditation, prayer, and the study of the Vedas (considered as one of the five great Yajñas and necessary duties); अहुतं च हुतं चैव तथा प्रहुतमेव च। ब्राह्मं हुतं प्राशितं च पञ्च यज्ञान् प्रचक्षते ॥
not allowed to partake of a sacrifice.
आहुत [āhuta], p. p. Offered to the gods, sacrificed.
तम् An offering made to men, hospitality.
The nourishment of all created beings (भूतयज्ञ or मनुष्ययज्ञ), regarded as one of the five principal sacrifices of the Hindus cf. पञ्चमहायज्ञ.
Called, invoked, invited; यियक्षमाणेनाहूतः पार्थेनाथ द्विषन्मुरम् Śi.2.1.
Named, called. -तम् Calling.-Comp. -प्रपलायिन् m. a defendant or witness not appearing when summoned. -संप्लवः the time of universal destruction.
आहुकः [āhukḥ], N. of a prince, grand-father of Kṛiṣṇa. -काः N. of a people.
Offering an oblation to a deity, any solemn rite accompanied with oblations; होतुराहुतिसाधनम्
An oblation offered to a deity.
आहुतीकृ [āhutīkṛ] भू [bhū], भू To offer, to become an oblation; Ratn.; B. R.
आहुल्यम् [āhulyam], N. of a leguminous shrub (तगर, तरवट &c.)
To be bent down or brought near.
To be made favourable; जने न शेव आहूर्यः सन्
